name: Match page prediction, lineup and odds render correctly in both light and dark
description: Match page prediction, lineup and odds render correctly in both light and dark.

planSteps.description: Open a /match/<id> page in light mode and confirm the predicted scoreline + win-probability bars, the lineup/formation, and the odds section are visible
Toggle to dark mode and re-check the same prediction, lineup and odds blocks
Verify the prediction bars, lineup, and odds all render legibly in BOTH modes — none disappear, lose contrast to invisibility, or break layout under the re-skin.
